note: Help-centre guides written by the Nagarik team. Each guide links to the page that does the task.

posts.title: How to report a civic issue in under a minute
posts.summary: Pick a category, add a photo, confirm the pin and submit. You get an NGK tracking ID straight away.
posts.author: Nagarik help team

posts.title: Documents usually needed for a passport
posts.summary: Proof of address and date of birth, plus your old passport for a re-issue. Always confirm on Passport Seva before you apply.
posts.author: Nagarik help team

posts.title: Updating your Aadhaar address online
posts.summary: Log in to myAadhaar with OTP, upload a valid proof of address and keep your Update Request Number to track it.
posts.author: Nagarik help team

posts.title: Tracking applications and reports in one place
posts.summary: Use your NGK ID for civic reports, and save official reference numbers so Nagarik can remind you to check their status.
posts.author: Nagarik help team

posts.title: Lost money to online fraud? Act in the first hours
posts.summary: Call 1930, file a complaint on cybercrime.gov.in and inform your bank. Speed improves the chance of recovery.
posts.author: Nagarik help team

posts.title: How to download or delete your Nagarik data
posts.summary: Open the Privacy & Security centre to export everything we hold or permanently delete your account.
posts.author: Nagarik help team
